salmanshh_platformer_navigationgraph.name: Platformer Navigation Graph
salmanshh_platformer_navigationgraph.description: AI pathfinding for platformer games with jumping and falling

enable_debug.name: Enable Debug Logging
enable_debug.desc: Show helpful debug messages in browser console (F12) to troubleshoot pathfinding issues. Disable for better performance in final game.

cell_size.name: Cell Size
cell_size.desc: Size of each grid square in pixels. MUST match the Cell Size in your Pathfinding behavior! Smaller = more precise paths but slower performance.

character_height.name: Character Height
character_height.desc: Height of your character in pixels. Used to check if character can fit under platforms when jumping or moving. Should match your sprite's collision box height.

max_search_nodes.name: Max Search Nodes
max_search_nodes.desc: Maximum pathfinding effort before giving up. Higher = finds paths in larger levels but may cause lag. Lower = faster but may fail on complex paths.

setup_preset.name: Setup Preset
setup_preset.desc: Pre-configured jump/fall settings. Auto: detects from Platform behavior. Beginner: short jumps, safe falls. Intermediate: moderate mobility. Advanced: maximum jump/fall distances for complex levels.

max_jump_height.name: Max Jump Height
max_jump_height.desc: Highest platform your character can jump to reach (in pixels). Should match your Platform behavior's jump strength. AI will only attempt jumps within this limit.

max_jump_distance.name: Max Jump Distance
max_jump_distance.desc: Farthest gap your character can jump across (in pixels). Should match your character's movement speed and jump duration. AI won't attempt longer jumps.

max_fall_distance.name: Max Fall Distance
max_fall_distance.desc: Maximum height your character can safely fall from (in pixels). AI will avoid longer drops that might cause damage or death in your game.

auto_control.name: Auto-Control Movement
auto_control.desc: When enabled, AI automatically controls the character (moves left/right, jumps). When disabled, you handle movement yourself using the path data.

graph_mode.name: Graph Mode
graph_mode.desc: How navigation data is stored. Shared = all characters use same map (efficient). Per-Instance = each character has own map (rare use cases only).

enable_portals.name: Enable Portals
enable_portals.desc: Allow AI to use special connections like teleporters, ladders, elevators, or doors. Disable if your game doesn't have these features.

smooth_paths.name: Smooth Paths
smooth_paths.desc: Remove unnecessary waypoints for more natural movement. AI will take direct routes when possible instead of zigzagging.

max_waypoint_time.name: Max Waypoint Time
max_waypoint_time.desc: How long (in seconds) AI tries to reach each waypoint before giving up and recalculating path. Prevents infinite loops when stuck.

enable_hazards.name: Enable Hazard Avoidance
enable_hazards.desc: AI will try to avoid dangerous areas like spikes, fire, or enemy patrol zones. Makes pathfinding slower but smarter.

AddCircleHazard.display-text: Add circle hazard at ({0},{1}) radius {2} severity {3}
AddCircleHazard.description: Mark a circular area as dangerous. AI will avoid this region when pathfinding. Good for explosions, magic zones, or round enemy patrol areas.

radius.name: Radius
radius.desc: Size of hazardous area in pixels from centre

severity.name: Severity
severity.desc: How much AI avoids this area (1.0 = slight avoidance, 10.0 = strong avoidance)

AddRectHazard.display-text: Add rectangle hazard at ({0},{1}) size ({2}×{3}) severity {4}
AddRectHazard.description: Mark a rectangular area as dangerous. AI will avoid this region when pathfinding. Use for spikes, fire, enemy zones, etc.

x.name: X
x.desc: Left edge X coordinate in pixels, preferably use bounding box of hazard object

y.name: Y
y.desc: Top edge Y coordinate in pixels, preferably use bounding box of hazard object

width.name: Width
width.desc: Width of hazardous area in pixels, preferably use bounding box of hazard object

height.name: Height
height.desc: Height of hazardous area in pixels, preferably use bounding box of hazard object

severity.name: Severity
severity.desc: How much AI avoids this area (1.0 = slight avoidance, 10.0 = strong avoidance)

AddRectHazardGrid.display-text: Add rectangle hazard at grid ({0},{1}) size ({2}×{3}) severity {4}
AddRectHazardGrid.description: Mark rectangular region as hazardous using grid coordinates

gx.name: Grid X
gx.desc: Grid X coordinate of the hazard

gy.name: Grid Y
gy.desc: Grid Y coordinate of the hazard

ClearAllHazards.description: Remove all hazardous regions at once. Use this to reset the hazard map when changing levels or game states.

RemoveHazard.description: Remove a specific hazard by its unique ID number. Get the ID when adding hazards or use expressions to check.

hazard_id.name: Hazard ID
hazard_id.desc: Unique ID number of the hazard to remove

ClearObstacleMap.description: Remove the obstacle map and navigation graph

CreateCustomObstacleMap.description: Create empty obstacle map with specified dimensions (in grid cells)

GenerateNodesFromCustomMap.display-text: Generate navigation graph from obstacle map
GenerateNodesFromCustomMap.description: Build the navigation graph from the current obstacle map. Works with any obstacle map source (custom or from Pathfinding behavior). Call this after modifying the obstacle map manually.

LoadObstacleMapFromJSON.description: Load obstacle map data from JSON string

json.name: JSON Data
json.desc: JSON string containing obstacle map data

SetObstacleCell.description: Set whether a specific grid cell is Solid/blocked.

SetObstacleCellXY.list-name: Set obstacle cell at world position
SetObstacleCellXY.description: Set whether cell at world position is solid

UsePathfindingObstacleMap.description: Get the obstacle map from the Pathfinding behavior. This is the easiest way to set up platformer pathfinding! Just call this once at 'On start of layout'. If the map is already ready, it copies immediately. If not, it waits automatically. Triggers 'On Pathfinding map ready' when done.

autoRegen.name: Auto-Regenerate Navigation Graph
autoRegen.desc: Automatically build navigation graph after copying (recommended: Yes)

FindPath.description: Tell the AI to calculate and follow a path from current position to the target coordinates. Character will automatically move if Auto-Control is enabled. Enable 'Correct to ground' to automatically snap start/end positions to the nearest walkable ground.

correctToGround.name: Correct to ground
correctToGround.desc: Automatically snap start and target positions to the nearest walkable ground position. Useful when positions may be in mid-air.

RegenerateGraph.description: Rebuild the pathfinding map from scratch. Use this after moving platforms or changing the level layout during gameplay.

StopPathfinding.description: Stop the character immediately and clear the current path. Character will stand still until given a new path.

AddPortal.description: Create a special connection between two points (teleporter, ladder, elevator, door). AI can use this to instantly travel between locations.

type.name: Type
type.desc: What kind of portal connection this represents

Is_Position_Hazardous.description: Check if a specific coordinate is inside any hazardous area. Returns true if position is dangerous, false if safe.

x.name: X
x.desc: X coordinate in pixels to check

y.name: Y
y.desc: Y coordinate in pixels to check

IsCellSolidGrid.description: Check if a specific grid cell is blocked/solid. Use grid coordinates (cell numbers, not pixels).

IsCellSolidWorld.description: Check if a grid cell at a world position (in pixels) is blocked/solid. Automatically converts pixel coordinates to grid cell.

IsSettingUpPathfinding.description: True if currently waiting for the Pathfinding behavior's obstacle map to become ready.

OnObstacleMapCreated.description: Triggered when obstacle map is created or regenerated

OnObstacleMapRemoved.description: Triggered when obstacle map is cleared

OnPathfindingMapFailed.description: Triggered if getting the Pathfinding map fails. Usually means no Pathfinding behavior exists on this object.

OnPathfindingMapReady.description: Triggered when 'Wait for Pathfinding obstacle map' succeeds. This means the obstacle map is copied and ready - you can now use 'Find path to position'!

OnPathfindingMapTimeout.description: Triggered if waiting for Pathfinding map takes too long (~10 seconds). Make sure Pathfinding behavior exists and has obstacles to detect.

HasPath.description: Check if the character is currently following a path to a destination. True while moving, false when stopped or path completed.

NodeExistsGrid.description: Check if a navigation node exists at the specified grid coordinates. A node exists where the character can stand (empty cell above a solid cell).

NodeExistsWorld.description: Check if a navigation node exists at the specified world position (pixels). Automatically converts to grid coordinates.

OnGraphGenerated.description: Triggered when the navigation graph finishes creating all nodes and their connections. Use this to know when pathfinding is ready to use.

OnPathFailed.description: Triggered when pathfinding fails to find a valid route to the target. Use this to handle unreachable destinations.

OnPathFound.description: Triggered when a path is successfully calculated to the target. Use this to react when the AI finds a valid route.

CalculatedJumpDistance.description: Get the maximum horizontal distance the AI thinks your character can jump (in pixels). Compare with actual performance for tuning.

CalculatedJumpHeight.description: Get the maximum jump height the AI thinks your character can reach (in pixels). Compare with your actual jump height for tuning.

PlatformJumpStrength.description: Get the jump strength value from the Platform behavior. Used for debugging jump height calculations.

HazardCount.description: Get the total number of hazardous regions currently active. Useful for debugging or UI display.

HazardSeverity.description: Get the hazard severity at a position. Returns 1.0 for safe areas, higher values for more dangerous areas.

x.name: X
x.desc: X position in pixels to check

y.name: Y
y.desc: Y position in pixels to check

IsPositionHazardous.description: Check if a position is inside any hazardous area. Returns 1 if dangerous, 0 if safe.

x.name: X
x.desc: X position in pixels to check

y.name: Y
y.desc: Y position in pixels to check

GridCellSize.description: Get the grid cell size in pixels.

GridHeight.description: Get the height of the navigation grid in cells (not pixels). Multiply by cell size to get pixel height.

GridWidth.description: Get the width of the navigation grid in cells (not pixels). Multiply by cell size to get pixel width.

IsCellSolid.description: Check if a specific grid cell is blocked by an obstacle. Returns 1 if blocked/solid, 0 if clear/walkable.

ObstacleMapJSON.description: Get the obstacle map as a JSON text string. Use this to save level layouts to Local Storage or send to server.

ObstacleMapSource.description: Get how the obstacle map was created. Returns 'pathfinding' (from Pathfinding behavior), 'custom' (manually set), or 'none' (not generated yet).

WaitTickCount.description: Get how many ticks spent waiting for Pathfinding map. Useful for debugging if it's taking too long.

WorldToGridX.description: Convert a world X coordinate (in pixels) to grid X coordinate. Use this to check which cell a position is in.

x.name: X
x.desc: World X position in pixels to convert

WorldToGridY.description: Convert world Y to grid Y

y.name: Y
y.desc: Y Position to convert to grid Y position

CurrentWaypointX.description: Get the X position of the current waypoint in pixels. Returns -1 if no active path.

CurrentWaypointY.description: Get the Y position of the current waypoint in pixels. Returns -1 if no active path.

NodeWorldX.description: Get the pixel X position of a node at grid coordinates. Returns -1 if no node exists at that position.

NodeWorldY.description: Get the pixel Y position of a node at grid coordinates. Returns -1 if no node exists at that position.

PathLength.description: Number of waypoints in current path

WaypointGridX.description: Get the grid X coordinate of the waypoint at the specified index. Returns -1 if index is invalid.

WaypointGridY.description: Get the grid Y coordinate of the waypoint at the specified index. Returns -1 if index is invalid.

WaypointX.description: Get the world X position (pixels) of the waypoint at the specified index. Returns -1 if index is invalid.

WaypointY.description: Get the world Y position (pixels) of the waypoint at the specified index. Returns -1 if index is invalid.
